headline: Nifty Posts Best Single-Day Gain Since April, Crosses 24,500
summary: India's Nifty index posted its best single-day gain since April, crossing 24,500 for the first time in three months, led by a 3.33% surge in Bank Nifty.
why: Benchmark index rallies reflect improving domestic market sentiment and strong sectoral buying participation by institutional investors.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The Nifty 50 index surged past 24,500 in its strongest single-day gain since April.
